claims: Lowe's stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, to allow employees to spend time with their families.
All U.S. Lowe's locations will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Lowe's stores will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026, for normal business hours.
Lowe's offers online-only deals on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Home Depot is open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, with reduced hours
